close_reason: Removed dead let _ = txt.policy_id line; renamed txt to _txt to make intent explicit
description: relay_client.rs:116: 'let _ = txt.policy_id; // captured for cache keying; not stored'. policy_id is NOT used as a cache key — the key is rcpt_domain. Comment is wrong and misleads contributors. Fix: remove the variable and say 'DNS policy_id not used; in-memory cache key is rcpt_domain' or implement proper policy_id-based cache invalidation (stoa-owq35.4 context).
title: misleading comment on txt.policy_id in enforce_for_delivery
